name: grokcode
description: Let a remote MCP client drive OpenCode on your own PCs.

scripts.build: npm run build -w grokcode-shared && npm run build -w grokcode-agent && npm run typecheck -w grokcode-relay
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w grokcode-shared && npm run typecheck -w grokcode-agent && npm run typecheck -w grokcode-relay
scripts.test: npm run build -w grokcode-shared && node --import tsx --test packages/shared/test/*.test.ts packages/agent/test/*.test.ts packages/relay-worker/test/*.test.ts
